rules.prepare:
# As in Debian's rules: the build system is made from the gnulib # repository, which the gnulib package ships as a git bundle. The first # call of bootstrap checks out the commit of gnulib that bootstrap.conf # pins and copies nothing yet, so that gnulib-patch can apply the fixes of # the gnulib package to the clone before the second call uses it. cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" git clone "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gnulib/gnulib.bundle" gnulib ./bootstrap --gnulib-srcdir=gnulib --pull --skip-po (cd gnulib && "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/gnulib-patch") ./bootstrap --gnulib-srcdir=gnulib --gen
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-rpath \ --with-packager=Aeltra \ --disable-nls \ --disable-doc
